scopeAndNecessaryNewDomainChoices: FULL marks; all displayed fact E and mark exclusions empty; no cleaners, statics, ND, conditional sources, or custom pass models.
Proposed one-step policy is total over FLOW metadata: FLOW demands accept FLOW inputs, retaining same-prefix EXACT. Current abstract-demand mark eligibility is preserved.

All ordinary field instruction micro-edges are NORMAL STAR->STAR; DEMAND comes only from run1 source policy, ancestor application, input-layer propagation, or field limiting.
